impl prost::transfer::AsyncEncodeSink for FakeDsaSink<'_> {
    type Error = FakeDsaError;

    type BufMut<'a>
        = &'a mut Vec<u8>
    where
        Self: 'a;

    type PayloadState = FakeDsaPayloadState;

    fn encode_error(error: prost::EncodeError) -> Self::Error {
        FakeDsaError::Encode(error)
    }

    fn buf_mut(&mut self) -> Self::BufMut<'_> {
        self.buf
    }

    fn poll_put_payload(
        &mut self,
        payload: &[u8],
        state: core::pin::Pin<&mut Self::PayloadState>,
        cx: &mut core::task::Context<'_>,
    ) -> core::task::Poll<Result<(), Self::Error>> {
        let state = state.get_mut();
        if let Some(staged) = state.staged.take() {
            if staged.as_slice() != payload {
                return core::task::Poll::Ready(Err(FakeDsaError::ResumePayloadChanged {
                    expected: staged,
                    actual: payload.to_vec(),
                }));
            }

            self.buf.put_slice(&staged);
            self.completed_payloads += 1;
            return core::task::Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
        }

        state.staged = Some(payload.to_vec());
        self.pending_payloads += 1;
        cx.waker().wake_by_ref();
        core::task::Poll::Pending
    }
}

impl prost::transfer::AsyncEncodeSink for FakeDsaSink<'_> {
    type Error = FakeDsaError;

    type BufMut<'a>
        = &'a mut Vec<u8>
    where
        Self: 'a;

    type PayloadState = FakeDsaPayloadState;

    fn encode_error(error: prost::EncodeError) -> Self::Error {
        FakeDsaError::Encode(error)
    }

    fn buf_mut(&mut self) -> Self::BufMut<'_> {
        self.buf
    }

    fn poll_put_payload(
        &mut self,
        payload: &[u8],
        state: core::pin::Pin<&mut Self::PayloadState>,
        cx: &mut core::task::Context<'_>,
    ) -> core::task::Poll<Result<(), Self::Error>> {
        let state = state.get_mut();
        if let Some(staged) = state.staged.take() {
            if staged.as_slice() != payload {
                return core::task::Poll::Ready(Err(FakeDsaError::ResumePayloadChanged {
                    expected: staged,
                    actual: payload.to_vec(),
                }));
            }

            self.buf.put_slice(&staged);
            self.completed_payloads += 1;
            return core::task::Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
        }

        state.staged = Some(payload.to_vec());
        self.pending_payloads += 1;
        cx.waker().wake_by_ref();
        core::task::Poll::Pending
    }
}

impl prost::transfer::AsyncEncodeSink for PendingOnceSink<'_> {
    type Error = prost::EncodeError;

    type BufMut<'a>
        = &'a mut Vec<u8>
    where
        Self: 'a;

    type PayloadState = PendingPayloadState;

    fn encode_error(error: prost::EncodeError) -> Self::Error {
        error
    }

    fn buf_mut(&mut self) -> Self::BufMut<'_> {
        self.buf
    }

    fn poll_put_payload(
        &mut self,
        payload: &[u8],
        state: core::pin::Pin<&mut Self::PayloadState>,
        cx: &mut core::task::Context<'_>,
    ) -> core::task::Poll<Result<(), Self::Error>> {
        let state = state.get_mut();
        if !state.returned_pending {
            state.returned_pending = true;
            self.pending_payloads += 1;
            cx.waker().wake_by_ref();
            return core::task::Poll::Pending;
        }

        self.buf.put_slice(payload);
        self.completed_payloads += 1;
        *state = PendingPayloadState::default();
        core::task::Poll::Ready(Ok(()))
    }
}

Existing `.proto` fixtures do not have one generated message combining all requested payload shapes; smallest proto to extend is `src/well_known_types.proto` `message Test` (currently bytes + map<string,bytes>) if the compatibility test must use prost-build generated code rather than hand-written derives.

files.description: `AsyncPayloadE2e` fields: scalar `int32`, repeated scalar bools, string `name`, bytes `payload`, repeated strings/bytes, `map<string,string>`, `map<string,bytes>`, nested message, repeated nested messages, map<string,message>, and two oneof fields.
`AsyncPayloadNested` nested payload message with scalar id, string name, and bytes payload.
`AsyncPayloadOneof` has bytes/string alternatives; `AsyncNestedOneof` has message/string alternatives.

Existing fake-offload async encode compatibility test constructs `AsyncPayloadE2e`, compares async `encode_raw_async` output with sync `Message::encode`, checks pending/resume counts, and decodes back to the same message.
`FakeDsaSink` implements `prost::transfer::AsyncEncodeSink::poll_put_payload`, stages payload across Pending, verifies resumed payload equality, then writes bytes.
Helper functions compare async sink encoding against synchronous `Message::encode`, preserving the constraint that sync `Message::encode_raw` remains unchanged.
`ScalarTypes` covers all scalar families plus plain/required/optional/repeated string and bytes (`Vec<u8>` and `Bytes` variants).
`Basic` covers scalar/string/optional string, string maps, oneof string, and `map<string, bytes>`.
`Compound` covers optional/required/repeated nested `Basic`, plus message maps.
Smallest existing proto fixture to extend for a generated all-payload test: `message Test { bytes bytes = 1; map<string, bytes> bytes_dict = 2; }`.
Generated fixture pieces: scalar-only `IntegerMsg` and `StringMsg` with string + bytes, but no repeated/map/nested/oneof payload coverage in one message.
Small generated oneof fixture with string and bytes oneof alternatives.
Generated nested/repeated/map message fixture, including `map<string, D>`, but no string/bytes payload fields.
`well_known_types.proto` is compiled with `config.bytes(["."])`; extending `message Test` here gives generated bytes fields using `Bytes` unless config is changed.

data.architecture: Recommendation for real DSA hardware encode compatibility: place the hardware sink behind the experimental DSA boundary and reuse `message_encoding.rs` async path shape. If hand-written test messages are acceptable, use `AsyncPayloadE2e` directly because it is purpose-built for `AsyncEncodeSink::poll_put_payload` and already exercises >20 resumable payload writes against sync encoding. If generated fixture coverage is required, extend `well_known_types.proto` `message Test` minimally with scalar, string, repeated string, repeated bytes, map<string,string>, nested message containing string/bytes payload, repeated/map nested message if desired, and oneof { bytes payload; string text; Nested nested }. Then add a generated-type encode compatibility test beside `async_encode_e2e_fake_offload_resume_matches_sync_and_decodes`, comparing real DSA sink output to `Message::encode` without touching Tonic codec or synchronous `encode_raw`.
